verdict.rationale: Abacum's security page documents a detailed edit history giving visibility into every edit event on data models, spaces and dimension mappings, which covers the change-logging half of the story. It does not state explicitly that the history records who made each change and when. No evidence shows that changes can be rolled back or restored. Missing for 10: documented rollback/restore of model changes, explicit who/when attribution in the log, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
